meta.method: Routine reports at minute 00/30 only for frequencies; SPECIs counted only for days-with. Wind 12 sectors of 30 deg centred on 000, 030 ...; speed bins kt [1-3,4-6,7-10,11-16,17-21,22+]. Calm = 00000KT. Crosswind/headwind from mean wind (and from gust where noted) vs runway true bearing; VRB and calm excluded from headwind fractions. Visibility = prevailing visibility, 9999/CAVOK = 10000 m. Ceiling = lowest BKN/OVC/VV. Density altitude: humid air, station pressure from QNH via ISA, Magnus (Alduchov-Eskridge) vapour pressure.

lcl_check.note: Lowest FEW/SCT base / (T-Td), 11-16 local, no precipitation, spread >= 3 C. Espy rule ~ 400 ft/C (125 m/C).
